overall_notes: Pair 3 clears the strict bar with all 4s. ALIGNMENT: C4 faithfully addressed across lesson and worksheet; expanded_walkthrough explicitly bridges Lesson 2 (data backbone) forward to Lesson 4 (reflect/refine) and Day 5 capstone. PEDAGOGICAL_DEPTH: trap is the rate-as-state confusion cited to Thompson & Saldanha (2003) 'Fractions and Multiplicative Reasoning' and Carpenter & Moser CGI 'measurement-rate' problem types; three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A rate-static, B can-multiply-but-no-rate-language, C won't-justify-with-data) give substitutes a clear branch point. INSTRUCTIONAL_BALANCE: puppets explicitly OPTIONAL with stuffed-animal / paper-bag / picture substitutes so the activity is unaffected; per-pair materials are teacher-made (charts, counters, number line); 12/25/13 = 50 min is realistic for Grade 2; movement-learner differentiation provides a no-paper number-line floor-mat alternative. CLARITY_VOICE: Mayor Mira anchors minds_on, action, and consolidation with the distinctive quotable refrain 'PER day, PER week, PER MONTH — math grows with TIME!' chanted at exit; all success_criteria start with 'I can'; vocabulary defined child-friendly. MATHEMATICAL_AUTHENTICITY: explicit conceptual progression from repeated addition to rule x time multiplication; misconception named in research-grounded terms (CGI, Thompson & Saldanha); children invent and refine their own rules at Station C with a 2-rule stretch. LESSON_WORKSHEET_CONSISTENCY: worksheet Parts 1-3 each map to a named success criterion and to lesson Stations A/B/C; Part 3 varies the format with an open invention/transfer task and is justified as the 'My Town Rule' generalization check; teacher_notes flags the same time-doesn't-multiply trap.
